jsPDF, jsPDF-AutoTable and Noto Sans (vendored, unmodified)
=============================================================

Used by: assets/js/calculators/common/pdf/ (Loan Comparison PDF download) only.
Loaded at the moment a PDF is requested, from this folder. Nothing is requested from another host.
Do not edit these files. To change one, replace it from upstream and update this notice and
tests/unit/jspdf-vendor.test.mjs.
